addAddMutedWordMenuItemInfo.message: Adds an "Add muted word" shortcut to the More menu, so muting a word takes one step instead of a trip through Settings.

addAddMutedWordMenuItemLabel_desktop.message: Add "Add muted word" to the "More" menu

addAddMutedWordMenuItemLabel_mobile.message: Add "Add muted word" to the slide-out menu

addFocusedTweetAccountLocationInfo.message: Adds the account's country under a post you have opened.

addFocusedTweetAccountLocationLabel.message: Show account location in focused tweets

addUserHoverCardAccountLocationInfo.message: Adds the account's country to the card that appears when you hover a name.

addUserHoverCardAccountLocationLabel.message: Show account location in user hover cards

alwaysUseLatestTweetsInfo.message: Opens Following instead of For you every time, so the timeline stays in time order.

alwaysUseLatestTweetsLabel.message: Use the Following (chronological) timeline by default

bypassAgeVerificationInfo.message: Skips the age check prompt. Changes no visible markup.

darkModeThemeInfo.message: Which dark theme to use: dim or lights out.

debugInfo.message: Enables debug logging and displays tweet debug info in the timeline

debugLogTimelineStatsInfo.message: Logs a per-timeline breakdown of what was hidden to the console.

defaultToLatestSearchInfo.message: Opens search results on "Latest" instead of "Top", so results are in time order.

disableHomeTimelineInfo.message: Find yourself wasting too much time on Twitter? Try preventing use of the home timeline

disableTweetTextFormattingInfo.message: Renders bold and italic markup in posts as plain text.

disableTweetTextFormattingLabel.message: Disable bold and italic text in tweets

disabledHomeTimelineRedirectInfo.message: Which page opens instead of the home timeline.

dontUseChirpFontInfo.message: Uses the system font instead of X's Chirp typeface.

dropdownMenuFontWeightInfo.message: Uses normal weight instead of bold for menu items.

dropdownMenuFontWeightLabel.message: Use normal font weight in dropdown menus

exampleAriaLabel.message: Show a before and after example

extensionDescription.message: Birdfeed gives you control over your Twitter/X experience. Customize what you see and enjoy a clean, quiet feed without the noise.

extensionDescriptionShort.message: Birdfeed gives you control over your Twitter/X experience. Customize what you see for a clean, quiet feed.

fastBlockInfo.message: Blocks immediately when you pick Block, with no confirmation dialog. There is no undo step.

followButtonStyleInfo.message: Whether Follow buttons use one flat colour or pick up the current theme colour.

fullWidthContentInfo.message: Hide the sidebar and let timeline content go full-width

fullWidthMediaInfo.message: Lets images and link cards use the full timeline width too, instead of keeping their original size.

hideAccountSwitcherInfo.message: Removes the account name and avatar at the bottom of the left navigation.

hideAdsNavInfo.message: Removes Ads from the navigation. Only appears on accounts that have it.

hideAllMetricsInfo.message: Hides every count at once, overriding the individual toggles below.

hideBookmarkButtonInfo.message: Removes the bookmark icon from the row under posts.

hideBookmarkMetricsInfo.message: Hides the bookmark count next to the bookmark icon.

hideBusinessNavInfo.message: Removes Business from the navigation. Only appears on accounts that have it.

hideComposeTweetInfo.message: Removes the floating "Post" button. You can still post from the box at the top of the timeline.

hideConnectNavInfo.message: Removes the Follow / Connect item from the navigation.

hideCreatorStudioNavInfo.message: Removes Creator Studio from the navigation. Only appears on accounts that have it.

hideEditImageInfo.message: Removes the Grok "Edit image" links that X adds to photos in posts and to profile settings.

hideExploreNavWithSidebarInfo.message: Brings Explore back when the sidebar is hidden, since search lives there otherwise.

hideExplorePageContentsInfo.message: Strips Explore down to just the search box - no trending, no suggested posts.

hideExplorePageContentsLabel.message: Hide Explore page contents and use it only for searching

hideFollowingMetricsInfo.message: Hides the following and follower counts on profiles.

hideForYouTimelineInfo.message: Removes the "For you" tab entirely, leaving only Following.

hideGrokNavInfo.message: Removes the Grok item from the left navigation.

hideGrokTweetsInfo.message: Removes posts that share a Grok conversation link.

hideGrokTweetsLabel.message: Hide posts sharing a Grok conversation

hideInlinePrompts.message: Hide inline prompts in the timeline

hideInlinePromptsInfo.message: Removes the prompts X injects between posts - follow suggestions, "complete your profile" and similar.

hideJobsNavInfo.message: Removes the Jobs item from the left navigation. Only appears on accounts that have it.

hideLikeMetricsInfo.message: Hides the like count next to the heart icon.

hideLiveBroadcastBarInfo.message: Removes the live video bar pinned above the timeline.

hideLiveBroadcastsInfo.message: Removes the live video block from the sidebar.

hideMessagesDrawerInfo.message: Removes the messages panel docked in the bottom right corner.

hideMetricsInfo.message: Hides engagement counts. The toggles below choose which ones.

hideMoreSlideOutMenuItemsOptionsLabel_de.message: Hide "More" menu items you don't use

hideMoreSlideOutMenuItemsOptionsLabel_mo.message: Hide slide-out menu items you don't use

hideMoreTweetsInfo.message: Removes the "Discover more" block appended below a post's replies.

hideNotificationLikesInfo.message: Keeps likes out of Notifications, so only replies, mentions and follows remain.

hideNotificationsInfo.message: What to do with the notification count: leave it, hide just the badge, or hide notifications entirely. Also applies to the browser tab icon.

hideProfileRetweetsInfo.message: Shows only a profile's own posts on its timeline, not what it retweeted.

hideQuoteTweetMetricsInfo.message: Hides the quote count next to the quote icon.

hideReplyMetricsInfo.message: Hides the reply count next to the reply icon.

hideRetweetMetricsInfo.message: Hides the retweet count next to the retweet icon.

hideSeeNewTweetsInfo.message: Removes the "Show N posts" banner that appears at the top when new posts arrive.

hideShareTweetButtonInfo.message: Removes the share icon from the row under posts.

hideSidebarContentInfo.message: Hides the whole right-hand sidebar. The toggles below hide individual blocks instead.

hideSortRepliesMenuInfo.message: Removes the "Sort replies" control from a post's page.

hideSubscriptionsInfo.message: Removes everything to do with paid subscriptions: Subscribe buttons on profiles and posts, the Subscriptions tab and count, the Subscribe menu items, and the subscriber badge on replies.

hideSuggestedContentSearchInfo.message: Removes suggested posts and accounts injected into search results.

hideSuggestedFollowsInfo.message: Removes the "Who to follow" block from the sidebar.

hideTimelineTweetBoxInfo.message: Removes the "What is happening?" box at the top of the home timeline.

hideTodaysNewsInfo.message: Removes the news block from the sidebar.

hideToggleNavigationInfo.message: Removes the control that collapses the left navigation.

hideTotalTweetsMetricsInfo.message: Hides the post count shown under a profile name in the header.

hideTwitterBlueRepliesInfo.message: Removes replies from paid accounts you have no connection to. The toggles below add accounts back.

hideTwitterBlueUpsellsInfo.message: Removes prompts to subscribe to Premium.

hideUnavailableQuoteTweetsInfo.message: Removes posts whose quoted post is from an account you blocked or muted, instead of showing an empty placeholder.

hideUnavailableQuoteTweetsLabel.message: Hide quotes and replies to blocked and muted accounts

hideUnusedUiItemsOptionsLabel.message: Hide UI items you don't use

hideVerifiedNotificationsTabInfo.message: Removes the "Verified" tab from Notifications and the Followers page.

hideViewActivityLinksInfo.message: Removes the "View post engagements" link under your own posts, and the matching menu item.

hideViewsInfo.message: Hides the view count shown under posts.

hideWhatsHappeningInfo.message: Removes the trends block from the sidebar.

hideWhoToFollowEtcInfo.message: Removes "Who to follow", "Topics to follow" and similar suggestion sections injected between posts, and the suggestion sidebar on profiles.

hideWhoToFollowEtcLabel.message: Hide suggested content in the timeline

listRetweetsInfo.message: Whether retweets appear inside Lists. Controlled separately from the main timeline setting, from a toggle on the List itself.

mutableQuoteTweetsInfo.message: Adds a menu item for muting quote tweets of a specific account.

navBaseFontSizeInfo.message: Uses normal-sized text in the left navigation rather than X's larger size.

navBaseFontSizeLabel.message: Use normal text font style in navigation bar

navDensityInfo.message: How much vertical space each left navigation item takes.

option_ignore.description: Option for not changing existing Twitter functionality - we don't use 'Ignore' for this in English as it could be mistaken to mean 'Hide'

option_separate.description: Option for showing Retweets or Quote Tweets in a separate tab from the main timeline

quoteTweetsInfo.message: Where quote tweets appear: mixed into the timeline, moved to their own tab, or hidden.

redirectChatNavInfo.message: Makes the Chat nav item open the older Messages page instead.

redirectChatNavLabel.message: Redirect Chat nav item to Messages

redirectToTwitterInfo.message: Sends x.com addresses back to twitter.com.

redirectTwitterLinksInfo.message: Rewrite twitter.com/x.com links to an alternative frontend when copying (leave empty to disable)

reducedInteractionModeInfo.message: Hide the action bar under tweets – replies are now the only means of interacting

replaceLogoInfo.message: Puts the Twitter bird back in place of the X logo, and restores the home and messages icons that came with it.

restoreLinkHeadlinesInfo.message: Puts the article headline back under link previews, which X reduced to a bare domain.

restoreOtherInteractionLinksInfo.message: Shows retweet and like counts as links under a post you have opened. Only on the post's own page.

restorePhotoGridInfo.message: Shows a post's photos as a grid - 2 side by side, 4 as a square - instead of a swipeable carousel.

restorePhotoGridLabel.message: Show multiple photos as a grid instead of a carousel

restoreQuoteTweetsLinkInfo.message: Shows the quote count as a link under a post you have opened. Only on the post's own page, and only if it has quotes.

restoreQuoteTweetsLinkLabel.message: Restore Quote Tweets link under Tweets

restoreTweetSourceInfo.message: Shows which app a post was sent from. Only appears on a post's own page, not in the timeline.

retweetsInfo.message: Where retweets appear: mixed into the timeline, moved to their own tab, or hidden.

showBlueReplyFollowersCountAmountInfo.message: The follower count a paid account needs for its replies to be kept.

showBlueReplyFollowersCountInfo.message: Keeps replies from paid accounts above the follower count set below.

showBookmarkButtonUnderFocusedTweetsInfo.message: Keeps the bookmark icon on a post you have opened, even though it is hidden in the timeline.

showPremiumReplyBusinessInfo.message: Keeps replies from verified Business accounts (gold check).

showPremiumReplyFollowedByInfo.message: Keeps replies from paid accounts that follow you.

showPremiumReplyFollowingInfo.message: Keeps replies from paid accounts you follow.

showPremiumReplyGovernmentInfo.message: Keeps replies from verified Government accounts (grey check).

showRelevantPeopleInfo.message: Keeps the "Relevant people" block when you open a post, even with the sidebar hidden.

showRelevantPeopleLabel.message: Show "Relevant people" when viewing a tweet

sortFollowingInfo.message: Forces the Following timeline to sort by most recent or by popularity, by rewriting the request X makes.

tweakNewLayoutInfo.message: Experimental - only enable if you have the new layout

tweakQuoteTweetsPageInfo.message: On the Quote Tweets page, hides the original post repeated under every quote.

tweakQuoteTweetsPageLabel.message: Hide the quoted tweet when viewing Quote Tweets

twitterBlueChecksInfo.message: What to do with paid blue checks: leave them, hide them, or replace them with a smaller badge.

unblurSensitiveContentInfo.message: Shows media marked sensitive without the click-through blur.

uninvertFollowButtonsInfo.message: Swaps the Follow and Following button styles back, so Follow is the filled one.

unmuteButtonText.description: Button used in the options page to unmute a muted Quote Tweet

unwrapTcoLinksInfo.message: Replace t.co links with the actual destination URL
